description: Gives the low, median and high asking price from current listings for a watch. Use it for questions such as "what does a 2021 Batgirl go for?".

brand.description: Brand name, such as Rolex or Patek Philippe.

dial.description: Only listings whose post names this dial colour, such as Black or Ice blue. Posts that do not name the dial are left out.

full_set.description: Only watches with box and papers.

our_stock_only.description: Only watches held by Watches in Stock itself, excluding other dealers. Set it only when the customer asks specifically for watches the store holds; "do you have", "what do you have" and "your cheapest" mean every listing.

query.description: What the customer asked for, in their words. Understands nicknames ("batgirl"), models ("daytona"), references ("126710BLNR"), years ("2016 or 2020") and budgets ("under 20k").

reference.description: An exact reference number, such as 126710BLNR or 5711/1A.

name: price_check
title: Check current prices
